parsed.post: Discarding the LR 0.1 experiment (1.1151). It seems 0.1 is too aggressive for this configuration without more warmup or lower batch size. Reverting to my best (LR 0.08, Warmup 0.1). Next, I'll try increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 to see if more stability allows a higher LR.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 to stabilize higher learning rates, reverting to previous best LR 0.08.
